messages:
Maria Chen: Quick alignment — sharing the minimal roadmap slice for Console Observability. Need owners + blockers for dashboards, tracing hooks, error-analysis views, and retention cutover by EOD.
Alex Rivera: Thanks — can you drop the exact milestone dates? Also calling out any runtime / infra deps up front would help. :eyes:
Maria Chen: Sure — rough plan: 
- Dashboards: week of 2026-04-22 — owner: Alex
- Tracing hooks (infra + runtime): week of 2026-04-29 — owner: Jen
- Error-analysis views (UI + backend): week of 2026-05-06 — owner: Dave
- Retention cutover (rollout + migration): week of 2026-05-13 — infra lead: Oliver
If you see issues, flag here.
Alex Rivera: Dashboards ✅ I can take the viz work. Blocker: need the trace backend indices available before we can feed the charts. Who owns creating those indices?
Jen Patel: That would be runtime infra. I have a PR for the hook insertion (https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/4321) but it needs a small schema bump from eng-runtime team (trace_id -> global_id).
Dave O'Neil: For error-analysis views we also need a normalized error shape from the trace events. The schema bump helps — otherwise we'll duplicate parsers. Planning to reuse the dashboard filters once trace fields are standardized.
Oliver Kwan: Retention cutover has two pieces: storage config + migration job. Storage config I can do; migration job needs a short freeze and a backfill window (estimated 36 hrs). We'll need signoff from compliance for <30d retention for debug logs.
sre-bot: Reminder: retention-migration stack will require a maintenance window. Please ensure tickets exist and are linked to the deployment.
Jen Patel: On the schema bump — I can open a follow-up against eng-runtime tomorrow AM. @Alex can you confirm chart fields you need so I include them in the PR?
Alex Rivera: Need at least: global_id, span_name, service, duration_ms, error_flag, env. If we can get span.tags as a JSON blob that's helpful.
Maria Chen: Quick ask — can owners drop the immediate blocker / ETA in this thread? I'll consolidate into the roadmap doc.
Jen Patel: Blocker: waiting on eng-runtime review of PR #4321. ETA: will chase today, aiming merge by EOD.
Alex Rivera: Blocker: trace indices availability — pinging infra to create index template. ETA: Thu 2026-04-18 if infra can prioritize.
Dave O'Neil: Blocker: need the normalized field mapping. If Jen's PR lands we can start UI work in parallel. ETA for my initial view: 2026-05-04.
Oliver Kwan: I'll own the migration ticket and template creation. Open ticket RDW-789 and link to this thread. ETA for template: 2026-04-18, migration schedule will be proposed after that.
Maria Chen: OK — action items I captured: 
- Alex: dashboards (viz), depends on index/template (Oliver)
- Jen: tracing hooks PR + schema bump -> follow up with eng-runtime
- Dave: error views, will reuse normalized schema
- Oliver: index template + migration ticket + compliance check
I'll update the roadmap and ping owners if any dates slip.
Alex Rivera: Sounds good. I'll add the chart field list to RDW-1122.
Jen Patel: If runtime needs a hand with tests, I can pair this afternoon.
Dave O'Neil: Happy to review UI edge cases once the schema is stable.
Maria Chen: Thanks all — please mark :thumbsup: once you've added your ticket/ETA. I'll compile into the milestone doc and post an updated timeline tomorrow.
